bug_semantics: Missing authorization (CWE-862) on plugin-administration endpoints. All plugin admin controllers inherit from CamaleonCms::Apps::PluginsAdminController, which applies only `before_action :init_plugin` (plugin activation check) on top of AdminController's `before_action :cama_authenticate`, which merely verifies a session exists (session_helper.rb: `def cama_sign_in?; !cama_current_user.nil?; end`). No role/capability check (`authorize! :manage, :plugins`) guards GET/POST /admin/plugins/<plugin>/settings, so any authenticated low-privileged user can read and overwrite plugin settings of the attack, front_cache, cama_meta_tag, and cama_contact_form plugins (the latter two are gem-mode plugins whose admin controllers inherit the same base class).
flaw_origin: The sink is the absence of an authorization filter in Apps::PluginsAdminController (originally Apps::PluginsAdminController). First-write of the flawed design is the repo's root commit 671a7ed178c7265e4c5d33d805a9b3a8cd7b3db6 ('Version 1.0', 2015-07-09, Owen <owen@skylogix.net>), which created app/controllers/apps/plugins_admin_controller.rb with `before_action :init_plugin` and no authorize filter, plus Plugins::Attack::AdminController and Plugins::FrontCache::AdminController with unprotected settings/save_settings actions (attack also accepts params[:attack][:msg], later rendered html_safe into unauthenticated pages), all inheriting AdminController whose only gate is `before_action :authenticate` -> `signin?` (any logged-in user). Routes are drawn unconditionally from each plugin's config/routes_admin.txt (lib/plugin_routes.rb). This is a from-birth design flaw of the plugin-admin surface: the smallest surviving object covering the sink is the root commit itself.

Verdict NOT_AI. The named sink — plugin-admin endpoints reachable by any authenticated user because the shared PluginsAdminController carries only init_plugin (activation) on top of authentication-only AdminController — was written at the repository's root commit 671a7ed1 (2015-07-09, human author Owen Peredo, no AI markers, sentinel NONE-671A7E). The root commit is a valid BIC here: it is the first write of the smallest surviving object (the unprotected base controller + unprotected plugin admin controllers), and its parent is the empty tree (root commit, introducer_parent_absent=true). The flaw persisted unchanged through 2.9.1 (2025-03-15). The fix is a clean two-stage wave in April 2026 (1856522a partial per-controller checks, then d2bb635b centralizing `before_action :authorize_plugin` -> `authorize! :manage, :plugins` in the base class), both by texpert, both marker-free, first shipped in tag 2.9.2. BIC-only attribution: the fix wave and both merge commits carry no AI markers, and the many 2026 texpert commits elsewhere in the repo with Co-Authored-By: Claude trailers (e.g. 5530e9b4, 408287b6, bfcdeb3f) are fix-side evidence only and do not touch the 2015 BIC.
